scope: sole-comb HOST source only: the Bend 2 files under bin/, lib/, surface/, wasm/ and dev/. The sole-comb object language has no @unsafe (Q2+Q3).
unsafe_meaning: These scoped host functions bypass Bend termination checking. Type, affine-use and exhaustiveness checks remain required. A new entry needs a reviewed registry change.
catchall_meaning: These named host sites use a catch-all match pattern for scalar dispatch, parser fallback or explicit refusal. A new site needs a reviewed registry change.

unsafe.reason: The positive Nat argument is divided by the literal 32768 on each recursion, strictly decreasing to zero. Type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.
Normalized nonnegative radix-32768 magnitude is divided by the literal 10 on each recursion. Trimming quotient limbs makes the magnitude strictly decrease to the empty zero representation.

Each worklist step removes one term node and prepends only its strict subterms. The total syntax-node count of the pending finite forest decreases by one. The stack preserves the pinned shape, address, scrutinee, motive and branch order. Bend cannot infer this measure through scan_term; type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

Linear suspended programs compose result continuations without mutually recursive Bend declarations. Recursive composition occurs only when a request resumes. Bend cannot establish the semantic decrease through the continuation. Type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

The error handler is threaded through a linear suspended program so failed annotation probes are caught after nested requests finish. Recursive traversal is delayed in the continuation; Bend cannot prove its decrease. Type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

The evaluator/converter executes typed requests and resumes their linear continuations. Semantic evaluation and readback decrease on the checked strongly normalizing fragment, a measure Bend cannot infer through closures. Unchecked raw terms may diverge as in the pinned OCaml evaluator; this declaration does not claim totality for arbitrary syntax. Type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

The signed collection width is checked nonnegative before this loop. Each step decrements its positive remaining count without wraparound. Bend cannot infer this numeric measure through Int63.pred; type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

Each worklist expansion replaces one syntax node by its strict subterms and literal text. Text is consumed on the next step, so the finite pending syntax measure decreases. Bend cannot infer this measure through the expansion type; type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.

The checker executes typed requests and resumes linear continuations. Every inference request consumes the shared remaining budget, including nested requests. Evaluation and conversion retain the pinned strongly normalizing checked-fragment assumption; arbitrary unchecked semantic values may diverge as in the oracle. Type, affine-use and exhaustive checks remain enabled.
